# Project Guidelines

## Instruction Files

Before making code changes, read this file and any other applicable instruction files in the affected directories.

## Function Documentation

For each new function, add a JSDoc-style header that briefly describes its purpose and documents every parameter, return value, and thrown error where applicable. Do not add documentation retroactively to unrelated existing functions unless explicitly asked to.

## Code Comments

Prioritize adding new comments when generating new code. Add comments only when they explain non-obvious reasoning, constraints, or why an approach is necessary. Do not comment code merely to restate what it does when that is self-evident.
